statement: The function returns a result r (a vector of vectors of i64) and r satisfies the following. Let L = min_{0 <= i < len(buildings)} left_i and R = max_{0 <= i < len(buildings)} right_i. For real x, define H(x) = max({0} ∪ {height_i | 0 <= i < len(buildings) and left_i <= x < right_i}). Let m = len(r). Then: (a) m >= 2; (b) for every j with 0 <= j < m, len(r[j]) = 2; (c) writing x_j = r[j][0] and y_j = r[j][1], we have x_0 = L; (d) x_{m-1} = R and y_{m-1} = 0; (e) for every j with 0 <= j < m-1, x_j < x_{j+1}; (f) for every j with 0 <= j < m, y_j = H(x_j); (g) for every j with 0 <= j < m-1 and every real x with x_j <= x < x_{j+1}, H(x) = y_j; (h) for every j with 0 <= j < m-1, y_j != y_{j+1}.
